story.zh: 刘备势力鼎盛，而曹军在汉中战事不利，局势动荡。关羽北上襄樊，意欲扩大战果...
story.en: Liu Bei's Faction is at the height of its power, while Cao Cao's forces suffer setbacks in Hanzhong, leaving the realm in turmoil. Guan Yu marches north against Xiangfan, seeking to expand his victories...

trigger.zh: 刘关张、关平、曹操、曹仁、孙权存活。成都、汉中属刘备，襄阳属曹操，江夏属孙权。孙权势力至少有5名武将。
trigger.en: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Guan Ping, Cao Cao, Cao Ren, and Sun Quan are alive. Chengdu and Hanzhong belong to Liu Bei, Xiangyang belongs to Cao Cao, and Jiangxia belongs to Sun Quan. Sun Quan's Faction has at least 5 Officers.

forbidden.zh: 主角是糜芳、傅士仁时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Mi Fang or Fu Shiren.

participate.en: 【Belong to Liu Bei's or Cao Cao's Faction】

defy.zh: 【<刘备势力><与庞德关系等级至少为2级>收庞德为家将】
defy.en: 【<Liu Bei's Faction><Relationship level with Pang De is at least Level 2> Recruit Pang De as a Retainer】

force.zh: 刘备身为君主并占领<成都><江陵><汉中>
force.en: Liu Bei is Ruler and occupies <Chengdu><Jiangling><Hanzhong>

force.zh: 曹操身为君主并占领<许昌><襄阳><宛>
force.en: Cao Cao is Ruler and controls <Xuchang>, <Xiangyang>, and <Wan>.

force.zh: 孙权身为君主并占领<江夏>
force.en: Sun Quan is Ruler and occupies <Jiangxia>.

force.zh: 关羽、张飞、周仓、关平回归刘备势力
force.en: Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhou Cang, and Guan Ping return to Liu Bei's Faction.

force.zh: 徐晃、于禁、庞德、曹仁回归曹操势力
force.en: Xu Huang, Yu Jin, Pang De, and Cao Ren return to Cao Cao's Faction

force.zh: 韩当、张昭、吕蒙、陆逊、蒋钦、潘璋、马忠回归孙权势力
force.en: Han Dang, Zhang Zhao, Lu Meng, Lu Xun, Jiang Qin, Pan Zhang, and Ma Zhong return to Sun Quan's Faction.
